ja200:1.1: One is handsome, one is elder,
ja200:1.2: one of good birth, one virtuous,
ja200:1.3: We ask the brahmin about this:
ja200:1.4: which one of these suitors is good?
ja200:2.1: There is good in the body,
ja200:2.2: we must pay respects to an elder,
ja200:2.3: There is good in being well born,
